changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'security' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Rule') BEGIN create table [security].[Rule] ( Id bigint identity not null, [Uid] uniqueidentifier not null, [Name] nvarchar(250) not null, RoleId int not null, SecurityType int not null, AssetTypeId int not null, ApplyToType bit not null, IsVisible bit not null, IsOverride bit not null, CreatedBy int not null, CreatedOn datetime not null, UpdatedBy int not null, UpdatedOn datetime not null, constraint [PK_Security_Rule] primary key clustered ( Id ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Security_Rule_Uid_Include') BEGIN create nonclustered index [IX_Security_Rule_Uid_Include] on [security].[Rule] ( [Uid] ) include (RoleId, AssetTypeId) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Security_Rule_AssetTypeId_Include') BEGIN create nonclustered index [IX_Security_Rule_AssetTypeId_Include] on [security].[Rule] ( [Uid] ) include (RoleId) END
